• **"Bulb"** is also spelled correctly. It refers to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, or it could refer to an electric lamp consisting of a transparent or translucent envelope containing a wire filament.(बल्ब)
 
• **"Thunder" **is spelled correctly. It refers to a loud rumbling or crashing noise heard after a lightning flash due to the expansion of rapidly heated air.(गरज)
